create_MonteCarloSamples: create a MonteCarloSamples object from chain results with adaptive samples and log likelihoods
get_chain_MonteCarloSamples: get a restricted view of MonteCarloSamples data for a specific MCMC chain index
get_variable_MonteCarloSamples: get variable samples from MonteCarloSamples with optional thinning and adaptive step inclusion
to_inference_data_MonteCarloSamples: convert MonteCarloSamples to an arviz InferenceData object for posterior analysis
get_num_samples_MonteCarloSamples: get the total number of samples from MonteCarloSamples including or excluding adaptive steps
